baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence غافر الذنب, قابل التوب, شديد العقاب, and إليه المصير.
baseline_models.mechanism: A fault leaves a trailing aftereffect. Protective covering can interrupt that trail when a turn is received; if it remains unbroken, the aftereffect becomes punitive recompense and reaches its endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Covering a fault while protecting its bearer from its effect supplies the interruption mechanism.
The tail or ending image makes the fault an act with something trailing behind it.
Willing reception supplies the gate at which the offered turn is admitted.
Calling another to repent supplies an offered reversal rather than a merely private regret.
Punishment following a fault supplies the consequence path when interruption does not occur.
Becoming toward an endpoint closes both possible paths in a final outcome.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists forgiveness, acceptance, punishment, bounty, exclusive deity, and final return as separate attributes.
changed_reading.after: The verse maps two continuations of a fault: received turning can bring protective interruption, while an uninterrupted aftereffect hardens into punishment before the common endpoint.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قابل stands before العقاب in the utterance, while their branch inventories supply facing or before and rear, succession, or outcome.
baseline_models.mechanism: The QBL and AQB roots establish a front/rear and before/after axis. Acceptance faces the person at the forward threshold; punishment occupies the trailing side as what follows, and المصير names where the entire movement ends.

activation_trace.role: Facing one thing toward another turns acceptance into a forward encounter.
Precedence supplies the before-side of the temporal topology.
The rear of the foot and the trace left behind supply the corresponding after-side.
Succession makes punishment the event that comes in the wake of another event.
The final becoming or endpoint gives the axis a terminus.

changed_reading.before: Acceptance and punishment are contrasting predicates without an internal relation.
changed_reading.after: Acceptance and punishment occupy opposite positions in a temporal-spatial process: a turn can be met at the front, while consequence follows at the rear toward the final destination.

baseline_models.mechanism: طول supplies capacity, duration, reprieve, and even a long tether; شد supplies binding force; مصير supplies settlement. The resulting image is generous range inside an order whose boundary can still tighten and close.

activation_trace.role: The long, slackened tether supplies room for movement without loss of attachment.
Capacity, wealth, and favor make that room an expression of abundance.
Extension and delay supply a temporal interval rather than an instantaneous settlement.
Tightening a knot or bond supplies the enforceable boundary of the interval.
A place of decision or settlement supplies closure after the granted range.

changed_reading.before: ذي الطول means bounty placed beside severe punishment.
changed_reading.after: ذي الطول can also image a capacious, extended interval for movement and return, generous in range but bounded by an enforceable destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prayer of 40:7 places forgiveness inside expansive mercy and immediately joins turned persons, following a path, and being guarded from punishment. The doubled guarding of 40:9 and its narrative realization in 40:45 turn the cover of غفر into a forward protective perimeter around the person and the effects of the fault.

activation_trace.role: Protection from the fault's effect is the focus anchor for a prospective account of forgiveness.
Repeated seeking and granting of protective cover makes forgiveness an active operation.
Expanse opposed to constriction makes mercy the encompassing field in which cover operates.
The offered return identifies who enters the protective process.
Following behind converts turning into continued movement rather than a momentary utterance.
An extended traversable path gives the continued turn a direction.
Driving harm away by protection states the prospective function requested after forgiveness.
Doubled guarding from evils identifies protection itself as the enacted mercy.
Protection of the believing speaker from plotted harms narratively realizes the perimeter.

structural_cues: 40:7 orders seeking forgiveness, expansive mercy, turning, path-following, and guarding from punishment in one petition.
40:9 equates being guarded from evils with having received mercy.
40:44-45 moves from entrusting the affair to God directly into protection from the plot's evils.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protective-cover and harm-deflection images plus their sequence; I infer that forgiveness reaches forward to contain consequences, not only backward to erase a record. A live alternative is that forgiveness and guarding are coordinated but separate gifts.

changed_reading.before: غافر الذنب primarily removes or overlooks a past fault.
changed_reading.after: غافر الذنب also protects the turned person from the fault's continuing wake, with following the path describing life inside that protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired travel-and-look refrains at 40:21 and 40:82 place عاقبة beside those who were من قبل, while 40:21 attaches seizure to ذنوبهم and 40:22 repeats شديد العقاب. The focus verse's QBL/AQB topology therefore becomes an inspectable historical sequence: predecessors leave traces, faults trail effects, and the after-state arrives despite prior strength.

activation_trace.role: Facing supplies the forward threshold in the focus topology.
The ending and outcome image supplies the rear result of the focus process.
Physical movement makes the reader traverse space in order to inspect temporal consequence.
The predecessors' ending supplies the visible after-state.
Those before supply the temporal front against which their later outcome is viewed.
The tail image lets their faults function as trailing liabilities that catch up with them.
Concentrated force restates the focus description at the historical consequence.
Punitive recompense following fault identifies what the repeated severe outcome is.
The closing recurrence turns the outcome pattern into a whole-surah frame.
The repeated predecessors complete the second before/after pairing.

structural_cues: 40:21 and 40:82 repeat the command to travel and inspect the outcome of those before in nearly the same sequence.
40:21 places greater strength and surviving traces before seizure for faults; 40:82 says greater strength and traces did not avail.
40:22 repeats the focus phrase شديد العقاب immediately after the first historical inspection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact QBL/AQB recurrence, movement, traces, faults, and the repeated punishment phrase; I infer that the branch-level before/after pairing organizes the history. The alternative is ordinary use of unrelated derivations whose juxtaposition is not itself rhetorical.

changed_reading.before: The QBL/AQB topology is a focus-only lexical possibility.
changed_reading.after: The surah repeatedly asks the reader to move through the remains of those before and inspect their after-state, making the focus verse's front-facing reception and trailing consequence a historical diagnostic.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus المصير is unfolded as a contrast between temporary enjoyment and a home of settlement, then as our return to God and the inevitable being returned to Him. Destination is therefore not abstract fate but a settled homecoming into the jurisdiction of the sole deity.

activation_trace.role: Becoming toward an endpoint anchors destination as an achieved outcome.
A place of decision or abode lets the endpoint become a settled location.
Fixity and settlement distinguish the lasting home from temporary enjoyment.
Returning a thing to its place renders the destination as a return rather than an unknown terminus.
The sole object of worship is also explicitly the recipient of the return.
Inevitable return restates the destination regardless of when the promised outcome becomes visible.

structural_cues: 40:39 contrasts the world's temporary use with the hereafter as the home of settlement.
40:43 joins the ineffectual call of rival objects directly to our return to God.
40:77 closes the uncertainty of when punishment is seen by asserting return to God in either case.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies settlement, return-to-place, and repeated directional clauses; I infer that المصير combines outcome, abode, and jurisdictional homecoming. A live alternative is that the settlement and return passages merely share an eschatological topic without unpacking the focus noun.

changed_reading.before: إليه المصير says that all finally end up with God.
changed_reading.after: إليه المصير names a return into the only lasting settlement and the sole deity's jurisdiction, not merely arrival at an abstract endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 40:40 a bad act receives only its equivalent, while the righteous are provisioned without accounting; 40:61 names God's فضل. This makes شديد العقاب describe reliable concentrated force rather than disproportion, while ذي الطول carries the surplus side of the economy: capacity, increase, and gift.

activation_trace.role: Punitive recompense after fault anchors the negative side of the economy.
Capacity, wealth, favor, and benefaction anchor the expansive positive side.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the accounting relation.
Equivalence constrains the negative recompense to its matching measure.
An allotted gift supplies the positive distribution that exceeds the negative equation.
Counting and accounting supply the boundary that the positive provision explicitly exceeds.
Increase and remainder directly activate the surplus dimension of ذي الطول.

structural_cues: 40:40 restricts recompense for a bad act with only and its like, then removes حساب from provision for the righteous.
40:61 restates the divine relation to people as possessing فضل.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equivalence, accounting, uncounted provision, and increase; I infer that this asymmetry explains why severity and bounty stand together in 40:3. The alternative is that 40:40 states a general judgment rule without calibrating the earlier attributes.

changed_reading.before: Severe punishment and abundant bounty can appear as two equally unlimited opposite powers.
changed_reading.after: The surah bounds punitive recompense by equivalence but leaves provision beyond counting, so severity is exact and enforceable while the surplus belongs to ذي الطول.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah stages rival calls, a false addressee with no effective call, God's command to call and promise to answer, and لا إله إلا هو followed by sincere invocation. The focus exclusivity is therefore operational: one valid direction of address, one responder who receives turning, and one destination.

activation_trace.role: Worship and the object worshipped anchor the exclusive relation.
Willing reception lets accepted turning function as a responsive relation.
Opposed verbal inclinations stage two competing directions of address.
The rival destination's ineffective call exposes it as a dead address.
The command to call establishes the live address.
Answering speech supplies the explicit response from that address.
Submissive worship identifies refusal to call as refusal of the relation itself.
The exclusive object of worship is repeated immediately beside invocation.
Calling bends speech and attention toward the sole deity.
Exclusive separation from association keeps the address undivided.

structural_cues: 40:42 contrasts the group's invitation to association with the believer's call toward the Mighty, the Forgiver.
40:43 denies effective دعوة to the rival object and immediately asserts return to God.
40:60 joins call, answer, and worship; 40:65 joins no deity but Him, call Him, and exclusive devotion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rival and effective calls, explicit answer, worship, and exclusive devotion; I infer that لا إله إلا هو in 40:3 is a routing claim as well as an ontological one. The alternative is that the call passages exhort worship without specifically explaining قابل التوب.

changed_reading.before: لا إله إلا هو is a declaration of divine uniqueness between the attribute list and final return.
changed_reading.after: The declaration identifies the only live address: the one who receives a turn, answers invocation, and is also the destination of return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The life sequence of 40:67 develops through full strength toward an appointed term and explicitly marks what can occur before it. At 40:84-85, commitment made only after overwhelming force becomes visible no longer benefits. ذي الطول can therefore supply a long but bounded interval in which a turn may be received before disclosure converts possibility into settled consequence.

activation_trace.role: Long duration supplies the temporal extent of the interval.
Extension and reprieve make the duration usable as an opportunity.
Acceptance anchors the open state of the interval.
Punitive consequence anchors what follows when the interval closes.
Reaching full strength makes the interval developmental rather than empty delay.
Before marks an actual temporal side within the life-course sequence.
A fixed limit of time supplies the interval's boundary.
Overwhelming force supplies the disclosure event after which the response is coerced by sight.
Heart-settling assent appears here only once force has become visible.
The explicit absence of benefit marks the response as arriving beyond the useful boundary.

structural_cues: 40:67 sequences origin, growth, full strength, old age, possible earlier death, and an appointed term.
40:77 commands patience across uncertainty about whether the promised outcome is seen now, while return remains fixed.
40:84-85 place profession after sight of force and then deny that late profession benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies duration, before, appointed limit, visible force, late assent, and lost benefit; I infer a temporal boundary for received turning. The alternative is narrower: 40:85 limits only coerced faith after punishment is seen and does not define every case of repentance.

changed_reading.before: قابل التوب and ذي الطول suggest acceptance and bounty without an explicit temporal structure.
changed_reading.after: The possessor of long capacity grants a real interval for accepted turning, but the interval is bounded: assent first produced by sight of settled punishment is no longer the same available turn.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet-preserved non-dominant ت ب ب target under focus ت و ب, then the actual ت ب ب occurrence at 40:37. It remains traceable through the shared mapped root and the adjacent blocked path, but downstream prose must present it as a split-root activation, not claim that التوب lexically means ruin or cutting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: التوب at 40:3, including both mapped targets retained by the packet.

activation_trace.role: Calling another to return supplies the ordinary offered-turn side of the fork.
The non-dominant cutting image lets the offered turn be imagined as cutting a destructive course.
Being turned away supplies the blocked alternative to reorientation.
The extended path supplies the course from which Pharaoh is turned away.
Loss and ruin name the destination of the blocked course in the actual context occurrence.

changed_reading.before: قابل التوب receives repentance as a straightforward return.
changed_reading.after: On the packet's preserved split, accepted turning is also an offered cut from a course whose blocked alternative is shown at 40:37 terminating in tabab, loss and ruin.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The hand-reception and guarantee senses of QBL are distant from the ordinary syntax of قابل, so this cannot replace 'accepting repentance.' It remains anchored because the focus pairs acceptance with protective covering and the surah repeatedly realizes turning as divine guarding. Render it only as an analogy of taking the returner into protective charge.

activation_trace.role: Receiving what emerges into the hand supplies a transition-handoff image for the returning person.
Guarantee and assumption of responsibility supply the protective-custody role.
Covering that preserves a thing supplies the protection joined to reception.
The petition to deflect punishment from those who turned gives the custody image contextual traction.
Entrusting an affair to another supplies the social transfer into divine charge.
The resulting deflection of plotted harm supplies the enacted protection.

changed_reading.before: Acceptance approves the act of repentance.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, acceptance can also be pictured as receiving the returning person into protective responsibility, so the accepted act becomes a transfer of custody as well as an approval.

strongest_changes: Forgiveness became prospective protection from a fault's downstream effects, not only retrospective erasure.
Repeated QBL/AQB framing turned the focus sequence into a before/after consequence topology visible in history.
The judgment economy became asymmetric: negative recompense is equivalent, while provision and فضل exceed counting.
The closing ayat bounded the long interval for accepted turning before coercive sight of punishment.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence activated spatial and temporal branches that a flat attribute list would hide, especially the QBL/AQB axis, protective cover as harm-deflection, and the packet-preserved ت و ب to ت ب ب split realized by تباب at 40:37.
remaining_uncertainties: The QBL/AQB before/after topology may be deliberate rhetorical structure or lexicographic overactivation across ordinary derivations.
ذي الطول may support temporal reprieve in this context, but capacity, favor, and bounty remain the cleaner readings.
The non-dominant ت ب ب mapping and the protective-custody reading must remain exploratory analogies rather than lexical claims.
